notes.title: Kharon's Crypt - Even Death May Die Full Release is here!
notes.notes:
Early Access is Over

Kharon's Crypt - Even Death May Die full release is out now on Steam and Nintendo Switch

This update will be taking the game out of early access into full release. It includes the Free Release Expansion that adds over 3 hours of content to the base game and a new hardcore game mode. 

The Crypt awaits you!

--
Hebi Lee
--------------------
Creator, Director & Producer
Andromeda Project█

notes.title: Kharon's Crypt - February 1st - Free Release Expansion
notes.notes:
After the successful Kickstarter campaign that was funded in little more  than 15 hours, and following 4 years of hard work, Kharon's Crypt - Even Death May Die will be finally available on February 1st.

We'll end the Early Access and launch the full game with a Free Release Expansion. More than 3 hours of additional content, new enemies, new puzzles, a new souls like game mode and even secret bosses!

The full version of the game with the Free Release Expansion will also be releasing at the same time on Nintendo Switch. 

Thank you all for supporting us in our journey!

All the best,

Hebi Lee
